report.title.app.description: Heading of the report dialog when the thing being reported to the moderators is an app. "Report" is a verb.

report.title.user.description: Heading of the report dialog when the thing being reported to the moderators is a person's account. "Report" is a verb.

report.title.message.description: Heading of the report dialog when the thing being reported to the moderators is one chat message. "Report" is a verb.

report.title.received.description: Heading of the report dialog after the report was sent. "Report" is a noun here: the moderators now have it.

report.received.text: Report #{{number}} received. We’ll review it and notify you when review finishes.
report.received.description: Confirmation in the report dialog after a report was sent. {{number}} is the report's reference number; keep the # before it.

report.blockAppNote.text: Blocking hides this app and stops its notifications for you. It does not block any contributors. You can unblock it in Settings → Blocked apps.
report.blockAppNote.description: Explanation above the "Block app" button, shown after reporting an app. "Settings → Blocked apps" is the path to a Settings screen.

report.block.app.description: Button shown after reporting an app: hides that app from the person who reported it. "Block" is a verb.

report.block.appDone.description: Text of the same button after the app was blocked; the button is then disabled.

report.block.user.description: Button shown after reporting a person or their message: blocks that person. "Block" is a verb. {{username}} is their username; keep the @ before it.

report.block.userDone.description: Text of the same button after the person was blocked; the button is then disabled. {{username}} is their username; keep the @ before it.

report.privateMessageNote.text: Moderators will receive this message and its attachments. Your other private messages are not included.
report.privateMessageNote.description: Note in the report dialog when the reported message is from a private conversation: says what the moderators will be able to read.

report.reason.label.description: Label of the drop-down in the report dialog where the person picks why they are reporting.

report.reason.choose.description: Empty first option of the reason drop-down in the report dialog, shown until a reason is picked.

report.reason.spam.description: Reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: unwanted advertising or repeated junk.

report.reason.scam.description: Reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: an attempt to trick people out of money or accounts.

report.reason.harassment.description: Reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: someone is being targeted or bullied.

report.reason.hate.description: Reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: hateful content aimed at a group of people.

report.reason.threats.description: Reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: threats of violence or harm.

report.reason.sexualContent.description: Reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: sexual material or content that is dangerous to people.

report.reason.impersonation.description: Reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: an account pretending to be someone else. Offered only when a person is reported.

report.reason.other.description: Last reason for a report, in the report dialog's drop-down: none of the listed reasons. Picking it makes the details box required.

report.details.optional.description: Label of the free-text box in the report dialog when the person may leave it empty.

report.details.required.description: Label of the free-text box in the report dialog when the reason is "Other", so the person must explain.

report.identityNote.text: Your identity is visible to moderators, not to the reported person or app owner.
report.identityNote.description: Small note at the bottom of the report form: who will know who sent the report.

report.submit.description: Button at the bottom of the report form: sends the report to the moderators.

report.sending.description: Text of the "Submit report" button while the report is being sent.

report.error.send.text: Could not send your report. Try again.
report.error.send.description: Error in the report dialog when sending the report failed and the server gave no reason.

report.error.block.description: Error in the report dialog when blocking the reported app or person failed and the server gave no reason.

share.title.description: Heading of the dialog that shows an app's link so it can be copied and sent to someone. "Share" is a verb.

share.close.description: Accessible name of the X button that closes the share dialog.

share.audience.members.text: Only members can open it. Invite people to let them in.
share.audience.members.description: Line under the share dialog's heading when the app is private: its link works only for members of its community. "it" is the app.

share.audience.public.text: Anyone with a Homeroom account can open it.
share.audience.public.description: Line under the share dialog's heading when the app is public. "it" is the app. Homeroom is the product's name.

share.urlLabel.description: Accessible name of the read-only field in the share dialog that holds the app's link.

share.copied.description: Shown for a moment on the share dialog's Copy button after the link was copied to the clipboard.

share.copyFailed.description: Shown for a moment on the share dialog's Copy button when the link could not be copied to the clipboard.

share.invite.description: Button in the share dialog of a private app: closes it and opens the pane for inviting people to the app's community.

share.openInNewTab.description: Link in the share dialog: opens the app's address in a new browser tab. "Open" is a verb.

share.alsoAt.description: Small line under the link field in the Share dialog when the link offered is the project's own custom domain: the project's Homeroom address also works. {{address}} is that address without https://.

rename.title.description: Heading of the dialog for proposing a new display name for an app.

rename.current.description: Line under the rename dialog's heading. {{name}} is the app's present name; the numbered tag sets it in a different typeface and must stay around it.

rename.newName.description: Label of the text field in the rename dialog where the new name is typed.

rename.placeholder.description: Greyed example text inside the empty new-name field of the rename dialog.

rename.hint.text: 3–64 characters. This is the app's display name, and the URL won't change. Opens a PR that edits<0>dapp.json</0>; the rename applies once the PR is voted in and merged.
rename.hint.description: Help text under the new-name field of the rename dialog. PR means a pull request on GitHub. dapp.json is a file name and stays as it is, inside its numbered tag.

rename.submit.description: Button in the rename dialog: opens the pull request (PR) that proposes the new name. "Open" is a verb.

rename.submitting.description: Text of the rename dialog's button while the pull request (PR) is being opened.

rename.error.tooShort.text: Name must be at least 3 characters
rename.error.tooShort.description: Error in the rename dialog when the new app name is shorter than 3 characters.

rename.error.tooLong.text: Name must be 64 characters or fewer
rename.error.tooLong.description: Error in the rename dialog when the new app name is longer than 64 characters.

rename.error.same.text: New app name must differ from the current one
rename.error.same.description: Error in the rename dialog when the typed name is the name the app already has.

rename.error.failed.description: Error in the rename dialog when the server refused to open the pull request (PR) and gave no reason.

rename.error.network.text: Network error while opening rename PR
rename.error.network.description: Error in the rename dialog when the request to open the pull request (PR) could not reach the server.

closeIssue.title.description: Heading of the dialog that asks whether to put closing an issue to a group vote. {{number}} is the issue's number; keep the # before it and the numbered tag around both.

closeIssue.explanation.text: This opens a group vote. If it passes, the issue is closed here and on GitHub.
closeIssue.explanation.description: Line under the heading of the close-issue dialog: what pressing "Propose close" does.

closeIssue.reason.label.text: Why should this issue be closed?<0>(optional)</0>
closeIssue.reason.label.description: Label of the reason box in the close-issue dialog. The numbered tag sets "(optional)" in a lighter weight.

closeIssue.reason.placeholder.description: Greyed example text inside the empty reason box of the close-issue dialog: typical reasons for closing an issue.

closeIssue.reason.hint.text: Posted publicly on the GitHub issue when the vote passes.
closeIssue.reason.hint.description: Help text under the reason box of the close-issue dialog: where the typed reason will appear.

closeIssue.submit.description: Button in the close-issue dialog: starts the group vote on closing the issue. "close" is the act of closing the issue.

closeIssue.error.http.description: Error in the close-issue dialog when the server refused and gave no reason. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code.

closeIssue.error.detail.description: Error in the close-issue dialog when the request could not be sent. {{reason}} is the browser's own description of what went wrong.

allowance.title.description: Label at the left of the allowance box shown in the create-app, import and remix forms: how many apps this person may still create.

allowance.checking.description: Shown at the right of the allowance box while the person's allowance is being fetched.

allowance.serverFull.description: Shown at the right of the allowance box when the whole server has reached its limit of apps, so nobody can create one.

allowance.headline.noLimit.description: Summary at the right of the allowance box for an account that may create any number of apps, when how many it has is not known.

allowance.headline.usedNoLimit_one.description: Summary at the right of the allowance box for an account with no limit. {{count}} is how many apps it has created. Keep the middle dot as a separator.

allowance.headline.usedNoLimit_other.description: Summary at the right of the allowance box for an account with no limit. {{count}} is how many apps it has created. Keep the middle dot as a separator.

allowance.headline.slots_one.description: Summary at the right of the allowance box when only the limit is known. {{count}} is how many app slots the person has in total. An app slot is one unit of the allowance: each app a person creates, imports or remixes uses one.

allowance.headline.slots_other.description: Summary at the right of the allowance box when only the limit is known. {{count}} is how many app slots the person has in total. An app slot is one unit of the allowance: each app a person creates, imports or remixes uses one.

allowance.headline.used_one.description: Summary at the right of the allowance box. {{count}} is how many app slots the person has in total and {{used}} how many are taken. An app slot is one unit of the allowance: each app a person creates, imports or remixes uses one.

allowance.headline.used_other.description: Summary at the right of the allowance box. {{count}} is how many app slots the person has in total and {{used}} how many are taken. An app slot is one unit of the allowance: each app a person creates, imports or remixes uses one.

allowance.headline.slotsRequested_one.description: Line on the account panel of the profile, when only the limit is known and the person has asked the admins for more. {{count}} is how many app slots they have in total. Keep the middle dot as a separator.

allowance.headline.slotsRequested_other.description: Line on the account panel of the profile, when only the limit is known and the person has asked the admins for more. {{count}} is how many app slots they have in total. Keep the middle dot as a separator.

allowance.headline.usedRequested_one.text: {{used}} of {{count}} app slot used · more requested
allowance.headline.usedRequested_one.description: Line on the account panel of the profile after the person asked the admins for more app slots. {{count}} is how many slots they have in total and {{used}} how many are taken. Keep the middle dot as a separator.

allowance.headline.usedRequested_other.text: {{used}} of {{count}} app slots used · more requested
allowance.headline.usedRequested_other.description: Line on the account panel of the profile after the person asked the admins for more app slots. {{count}} is how many slots they have in total and {{used}} how many are taken. Keep the middle dot as a separator.

allowance.detail.admin.text: Admin accounts can create apps without a slot limit.
allowance.detail.admin.description: Explanation in the allowance box for an administrator's account, which has no limit on apps.

allowance.detail.unavailable.description: Explanation in the allowance box when the number of free app slots could not be worked out.

allowance.detail.unavailableSpent.text: Current usage is unavailable. Request more slots to create another app.
allowance.detail.unavailableSpent.description: Explanation in the allowance box when the number of free app slots could not be worked out and every slot is known to be taken.

allowance.detail.available_one.text: {{count}} slot available. Creating, importing and remixing share this allowance.
allowance.detail.available_one.description: Explanation in the allowance box. {{count}} is how many app slots the person still has free. Creating, importing and remixing are the three ways of making an app.

allowance.detail.available_other.text: {{count}} slots available. Creating, importing and remixing share this allowance.
allowance.detail.available_other.description: Explanation in the allowance box. {{count}} is how many app slots the person still has free. Creating, importing and remixing are the three ways of making an app.

allowance.detail.availableSpent_one.text: {{count}} slot available. Creating, importing and remixing share this allowance. Request more slots to create another app.
allowance.detail.availableSpent_one.description: Explanation in the allowance box when every app slot is taken. {{count}} is how many slots are free, normally 0. The last sentence points at the "Request more" button below.

allowance.detail.availableSpent_other.text: {{count}} slots available. Creating, importing and remixing share this allowance. Request more slots to create another app.
allowance.detail.availableSpent_other.description: Explanation in the allowance box when every app slot is taken. {{count}} is how many slots are free, normally 0. The last sentence points at the "Request more" button below.

allowance.server.fullNoLimit.text: This server is at its app limit ({{limit}}). Ask an admin to remove an app or raise the limit. Your own allowance: no limit.
allowance.server.fullNoLimit.description: Red line in the allowance box when the whole server cannot take another app, for an account that itself has no limit. {{limit}} is the server's maximum number of apps.

allowance.server.fullSlotsFree_one.text: This server is at its app limit ({{limit}}). Ask an admin to remove an app or raise the limit. Your own allowance: {{count}} slot free.
allowance.server.fullSlotsFree_one.description: Red line in the allowance box when the whole server cannot take another app. {{limit}} is the server's maximum number of apps; {{count}} is how many app slots this person still has free.

allowance.server.fullSlotsFree_other.text: This server is at its app limit ({{limit}}). Ask an admin to remove an app or raise the limit. Your own allowance: {{count}} slots free.
allowance.server.fullSlotsFree_other.description: Red line in the allowance box when the whole server cannot take another app. {{limit}} is the server's maximum number of apps; {{count}} is how many app slots this person still has free.

allowance.server.room_one.text: This server has room for {{count}} more app (limit {{limit}}).
allowance.server.room_one.description: Line in the allowance box when the server is nearly full and that is the limit this person will meet first. {{count}} is how many more apps the server can take; {{limit}} is its maximum.

allowance.server.room_other.text: This server has room for {{count}} more apps (limit {{limit}}).
allowance.server.room_other.description: Line in the allowance box when the server is nearly full and that is the limit this person will meet first. {{count}} is how many more apps the server can take; {{limit}} is its maximum.

allowance.request.more.description: Button in the allowance box: asks the admins for more app slots. "Request" is a verb.

allowance.request.sending.description: Text of the "Request more" button in the allowance box while the request for more app slots is being sent.

allowance.request.pending.description: Text of the disabled button in the allowance box once the person has asked for more app slots and the admins have not answered. "Request" is a noun here.

allowance.request.note.text: Admins have your request. You’ll be notified when it is reviewed.
allowance.request.note.description: Note under the disabled "Request pending" button in the allowance box.

allowance.refresh.description: Button in the allowance box, shown after the allowance failed to load: fetches it again.

allowance.error.load.text: Could not load your app allowance.
allowance.error.load.description: Error in the allowance box when the person's allowance could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

allowance.error.request.description: Error in the allowance box when asking the admins for more app slots failed and the server gave no reason.

appNotifications.title.description: Heading of the dialog where a person chooses which of one app's notifications they receive.

appNotifications.intro.named.text: What {{app}} can tell you about. Each of these covers the bell here and a notification on your phone, together.
appNotifications.intro.named.description: Line under the heading of an app's notification settings. {{app}} is the app's name. "The bell" is the notification bell in Homeroom's header.

appNotifications.intro.unnamed.text: What this app can tell you about.
appNotifications.intro.unnamed.description: Line under the heading of an app's notification settings while the app's name is still loading.

appNotifications.followDefault.description: Link under one kind of notification in an app's notification settings: drops the choice made for this app and uses the person's setting for all apps again.

appNotifications.source.account.description: Small note under one kind of notification in an app's notification settings: its switch shows the person's own setting for all apps, not a choice made for this app.

appNotifications.source.default.description: Small note under one kind of notification in an app's notification settings: its switch shows the built-in setting, because the person has not chosen anything.

appNotifications.note.text: Turning something off stops the notification, not the thing itself. New issues and proposals still appear on this app's board.
appNotifications.note.description: Footnote of an app's notification settings. The board is the app's list of issues and proposals.

appNotifications.error.load.description: Error in an app's notification settings when they could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

appNotifications.error.save.description: Error in an app's notification settings when flipping a switch could not be saved and the server gave no reason.

appSettings.title.description: Heading of the dialog with an app's access setting and its delete form.

appSettings.loading.description: Shown in the app settings dialog while the app's settings are being fetched.

appSettings.error.load.description: Error in the app settings dialog when the settings could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

appSettings.demo.notice.text: This app is in demo mode. Proposals and votes from <0>@{{partner}}</0> are synthetic: the app’s creator made them to record how a change is proposed, previewed and merged.
appSettings.demo.notice.description: Notice at the top of the app settings dialog of an app in demo mode. {{partner}} is the username of the made-up second member; keep the @ before it and the numbered tag, which makes it bold.

appSettings.demo.noticeUnnamed.text: This app is in demo mode. Proposals and votes from <0>@its demo partner</0> are synthetic: the app’s creator made them to record how a change is proposed, previewed and merged.
appSettings.demo.noticeUnnamed.description: The same demo-mode notice when the made-up second member's username is not known. Keep the numbered tag, which makes the words bold, and the @ at its start.

appSettings.demo.noticeApprovals_one.text: This app is in demo mode. Proposals and votes from <0>@{{partner}}</0> are synthetic: the app’s creator made them to record how a change is proposed, previewed and merged. While demo mode is on, a proposal here merges on {{count}} approval rather than on the app’s usual timed rules; switching demo mode off puts that back.
appSettings.demo.noticeApprovals_one.description: Demo-mode notice at the top of the app settings dialog, with the approval rule that applies meanwhile. {{partner}} is the made-up second member's username (keep the @ and the numbered tag); {{count}} is how many approvals merge a proposal.

appSettings.demo.noticeApprovals_other.text: This app is in demo mode. Proposals and votes from <0>@{{partner}}</0> are synthetic: the app’s creator made them to record how a change is proposed, previewed and merged. While demo mode is on, a proposal here merges on {{count}} approvals rather than on the app’s usual timed rules; switching demo mode off puts that back.
appSettings.demo.noticeApprovals_other.description: Demo-mode notice at the top of the app settings dialog, with the approval rule that applies meanwhile. {{partner}} is the made-up second member's username (keep the @ and the numbered tag); {{count}} is how many approvals merge a proposal.

appSettings.demo.noticeUnnamedApprovals_.text: This app is in demo mode. Proposals and votes from <0>@its demo partner</0> are synthetic: the app’s creator made them to record how a change is proposed, previewed and merged. While demo mode is on, a proposal here merges on {{count}} approval rather than on the app’s usual timed rules; switching demo mode off puts that back.
appSettings.demo.noticeUnnamedApprovals_.description: Demo-mode notice with the approval rule, when the made-up second member's username is not known. Keep the numbered tag and the @ at its start. {{count}} is how many approvals merge a proposal.

appSettings.demo.noticeUnnamedApprovals_.text: This app is in demo mode. Proposals and votes from <0>@its demo partner</0> are synthetic: the app’s creator made them to record how a change is proposed, previewed and merged. While demo mode is on, a proposal here merges on {{count}} approvals rather than on the app’s usual timed rules; switching demo mode off puts that back.
appSettings.demo.noticeUnnamedApprovals_.description: Demo-mode notice with the approval rule, when the made-up second member's username is not known. Keep the numbered tag and the @ at its start. {{count}} is how many approvals merge a proposal.

appSettings.access.heading.description: Heading of the section of the app settings dialog that sets who may use the app and who may build changes for it.

appSettings.access.intro.text: Choose who can use this app and who can build changes for it.
appSettings.access.intro.description: First line of the Access section of the app settings dialog.

appSettings.access.codePublic.text: The code is public on GitHub either way.
appSettings.access.codePublic.description: Second line of the Access section of the app settings dialog: even a private app's source code can be read on GitHub.

appSettings.access.groupLabel.description: Accessible name of the group of three access choices (Public; Public, invite-only building; Private) in the app settings dialog.

appSettings.access.mode.public.title.description: Access choice in the app settings dialog: anyone may use the app and build changes for it.

appSettings.access.mode.public.descripti.text: Everyone can use and build this app.
appSettings.access.mode.public.descripti.description: Explanation under the "Public" access choice in the app settings dialog. "Build" means writing changes to the app.

appSettings.access.mode.publicInvite.tit.description: Access choice in the app settings dialog: anyone may use the app, but only invited collaborators may build changes for it.

appSettings.access.mode.publicInvite.des.text: Everyone can use it. Only collaborators can build it.
appSettings.access.mode.publicInvite.des.description: Explanation under the "Public, invite-only building" access choice in the app settings dialog. "it" is the app; "build" means writing changes to it.

appSettings.access.mode.private.title.description: Access choice in the app settings dialog: only invited collaborators may use the app or build changes for it.

appSettings.access.mode.private.descript.text: Only collaborators can use or build this app.
appSettings.access.mode.private.descript.description: Explanation under the "Private" access choice in the app settings dialog. "Build" means writing changes to the app.

appSettings.access.current.description: Small tag on the access choice that is in force for the app now, in the app settings dialog.

appSettings.access.noRepository.text: This app has no GitHub repository, so its access setting is read-only.
appSettings.access.noRepository.description: Note under the access choices in the app settings dialog when they cannot be changed.

appSettings.access.changeNote.text: Changing access opens a proposal. The new setting applies after the group votes it in and the app redeploys.
appSettings.access.changeNote.description: Note under the access choices in the app settings dialog. A proposal is a change the app's members vote on.

appSettings.access.alreadyWaiting.text: A visibility change is already waiting for approval. See it in the Workshop.
appSettings.access.alreadyWaiting.description: Status in the app settings dialog when an earlier proposal to change the app's access has not been decided yet. The Workshop is the tab of the app's page that lists proposals; keep it as a name.

appSettings.access.opened.text: Proposal opened (PR #{{number}}). It needs the group's vote before the new access applies.
appSettings.access.opened.description: Status in the app settings dialog after the access change was put up as a proposal. {{number}} is the number of its pull request (PR) on GitHub; keep the # before it.

appSettings.access.error.text: Could not open the visibility proposal.
appSettings.access.error.description: Error in the app settings dialog when the proposal to change the app's access could not be created and the server gave no reason.

appSettings.access.propose.description: Button in the app settings dialog: puts the chosen access setting up as a proposal for the group to vote on.

appSettings.access.proposing.description: Text of the "Propose access change" button while the proposal is being created.

appSettings.access.proposalOpen.description: Text of the disabled "Propose access change" button once a proposal to change the access exists and is waiting for votes. "Open" is an adjective: the proposal is not decided yet.

appSettings.delete.blocked.core.text: This is a core platform app. It cannot be deleted from the UI.
appSettings.delete.blocked.core.description: Shown in the app settings dialog instead of the delete form, for an app that is part of Homeroom itself.

appSettings.delete.blocked.shared_one.text: This app has {{count}} other contributor, so no one person can delete it. Deleting a shared app needs the group's agreement.
appSettings.delete.blocked.shared_one.description: Shown in the app settings dialog instead of the delete form, for an app other people have contributed to. {{count}} is how many contributors there are besides the viewer.

appSettings.delete.blocked.shared_other.text: This app has {{count}} other contributors, so no one person can delete it. Deleting a shared app needs the group's agreement.
appSettings.delete.blocked.shared_other.description: Shown in the app settings dialog instead of the delete form, for an app other people have contributed to. {{count}} is how many contributors there are besides the viewer.

appSettings.delete.blocked.notOwner.text: You do not have permission to delete this app.
appSettings.delete.blocked.notOwner.description: Shown in the app settings dialog instead of the delete form, for someone who is not allowed to delete the app.

appSettings.danger.heading.description: Red heading of the section of the app settings dialog that holds the delete form.

appSettings.danger.explanation.named.text: Deleting {{app}} removes it for everyone, including its app data. This cannot be undone. It does not just remove the icon from your home page.
appSettings.danger.explanation.named.description: Warning above the delete form in the app settings dialog. {{app}} is the app's name.

appSettings.danger.explanation.unnamed.text: Deleting this app removes it for everyone, including its app data. This cannot be undone. It does not just remove the icon from your home page.
appSettings.danger.explanation.unnamed.description: Warning above the delete form in the app settings dialog, while the app's name is not loaded.

appSettings.danger.confirmLabel.description: Label of the text field in the delete form of the app settings dialog. {{app}} is the app's name, which the person must type exactly; the numbered tag makes it bold.

appSettings.danger.sharedAck_one.text: This app has {{count}} other contributor who have not agreed to this. Delete it anyway as a platform admin. They will be notified.
appSettings.danger.sharedAck_one.description: Label of a checkbox in the delete form, shown to a platform administrator deleting an app others contributed to. {{count}} is how many contributors there are besides the viewer.

appSettings.danger.sharedAck_other.text: This app has {{count}} other contributors who have not agreed to this. Delete it anyway as a platform admin. They will be notified.
appSettings.danger.sharedAck_other.description: Label of a checkbox in the delete form, shown to a platform administrator deleting an app others contributed to. {{count}} is how many contributors there are besides the viewer.

appSettings.danger.submit.description: Red button at the end of the delete form in the app settings dialog: deletes the app and its data for all its users.

appSettings.danger.deleting.description: Text of the "Delete app for everyone" button while the app is being deleted.

appSettings.danger.error.text: Could not delete the app. Try again.
appSettings.danger.error.description: Error in the app settings dialog when deleting the app failed and the server gave no reason.

appSettings.danger.deleted.description: Brief message shown at the bottom of the screen after an app was deleted from the app settings dialog.

boardFilters.title.description: Heading of the dialog that narrows which items an app's board shows.

boardFilters.subtitle.description: Line under the heading of the board filters dialog: an item must match every filter that is set.

boardFilters.priority.label.description: Label of the drop-down in the board filters dialog that filters items by their priority.

boardFilters.priority.any.description: First option of the priority drop-down in the board filters dialog: do not filter by priority.

boardFilters.priority.high.description: Option of the priority drop-down in the board filters dialog: only items of high priority.

boardFilters.priority.medium.description: Option of the priority drop-down in the board filters dialog: only items of medium priority.

boardFilters.priority.low.description: Option of the priority drop-down in the board filters dialog: only items of low priority.

boardFilters.category.label.description: Label of the drop-down in the board filters dialog that filters items by their category.

boardFilters.category.any.description: First option of the category drop-down in the board filters dialog: do not filter by category.

boardFilters.assignee.label.description: Label of the drop-down in the board filters dialog that filters items by the person they are assigned to.

boardFilters.assignee.anyone.description: First option of the assignee drop-down in the board filters dialog: do not filter by who an item is assigned to.

boardFilters.assignee.nobody.description: Option of the assignee drop-down in the board filters dialog: only items that are not assigned to anyone.

boardFilters.waiting.title.description: Label of a switch in the board filters dialog: show only proposals that still need this person's vote.

boardFilters.waiting.description.text: Only proposals you haven’t weighed in on yet
boardFilters.waiting.description.description: Explanation under the "Waiting on you" switch in the board filters dialog. To weigh in is to vote.

boardFilters.assigned.title.description: Label of a switch in the board filters dialog: show only items assigned to this person.

boardFilters.assigned.description.text: Only items the group voted onto you
boardFilters.assigned.description.description: Explanation under the "Assigned to you" switch in the board filters dialog: the group assigns an item to a person by vote.

boardFilters.created.title.description: Label of a switch in the board filters dialog: show only items this person opened.

boardFilters.created.description.description: Explanation under the "Created by you" switch in the board filters dialog. To open an item is to file it.

createProgress.title.creating.description: Heading of the progress panel shown after an app was asked for, while a new app is being set up. {{app}} is the app's name.

createProgress.title.importing.description: Heading of the progress panel shown after an app was asked for, while an app is being imported from an existing repository. {{app}} is the app's name.

createProgress.title.remixing.description: Heading of the progress panel shown after an app was asked for, while the person's own copy (a remix) of someone else's app is being made. {{app}} is the copy's name.

createProgress.title.live.description: Heading of the progress panel shown after an app was asked for, once the app is running and can be opened. {{app}} is the app's name.

createProgress.title.almost.description: Heading of the progress panel shown after an app was asked for, when the app is built but cannot start until its required secrets (keys it needs) are set.

createProgress.title.failed.description: Heading of the progress panel shown after an app was asked for, when setting the app up failed. {{app}} is the app's name.

createProgress.step.database.description: First of four steps listed in the app-creation progress panel, each with a tick, a spinner or a cross beside it.

createProgress.step.repository.description: Second of four steps listed in the app-creation progress panel: the app's code repository is being made.

createProgress.step.build.description: Third of four steps listed in the app-creation progress panel: the app's code is being compiled into something that can run.

createProgress.step.deploy.description: Last of four steps listed in the app-creation progress panel: the built app is being started so people can open it.

createProgress.status.pending.text: This usually takes under a minute. You can close this and keep going. We’ll finish in the background and your app will appear in your apps.
createProgress.status.pending.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel while the app is still being set up. "Close this" is closing the panel.

createProgress.status.live.text: Your app is running. Open it to see what it shipped with.
createProgress.status.live.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel once the app is running. "What it shipped with" is the starter content every new app has.

createProgress.status.liveBot.text: {{app}} is set up. Homeroom bot is building its first version from your description and will message you when it’s ready to try.
createProgress.status.liveBot.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel once the app is running and the assistant is writing its first version. {{app}} is the app's name. "Homeroom bot" is the assistant's name and stays as it is.

createProgress.status.liveRequest.text: Your project is ready. Its first request is waiting on its page.
createProgress.status.liveRequest.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel once the project is running and the person's description was filed as its first request (a request is an item asking for a change).

createProgress.status.needsNamedSecrets.text: Set {{secrets}} and your app will finish starting.
createProgress.status.needsNamedSecrets.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel when the app needs secrets before it can start. {{secrets}} is the list of the missing variables' names, such as OPENAI_API_KEY, STRIPE_KEY.

createProgress.status.needsSecrets.text: Set the required secrets and your app will finish starting.
createProgress.status.needsSecrets.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel when the app needs secrets (keys and passwords it uses) before it can start and their names are not known.

createProgress.status.stopped.text: Setup stopped before your app was running. Retrying usually clears a transient failure.
createProgress.status.stopped.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel, in red, when setting the app up failed and no reason was recorded.

createProgress.status.buildFailed.text: The build didn’t finish. Try again, or ask an admin.
createProgress.status.buildFailed.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel, in red, when the step that builds the app's code failed. "Build" is a noun.

createProgress.status.setupFailed.text: Setup didn’t finish. Try again, or ask an admin.
createProgress.status.setupFailed.description: Status line under the steps of the app-creation progress panel, in red, when a step other than the build failed.

createProgress.details.description: Label of the fold in the app-creation progress panel that, opened, shows the technical reason the setup failed.

createProgress.next.heading.description: Small heading above three numbered lines in the app-creation progress panel that say what follows once the app exists.

createProgress.next.open.text: Open your app and try what it shipped with.
createProgress.next.open.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel. "What it shipped with" is the starter content every new app has.

createProgress.next.describe.text: Describe a change in chat, and a coding agent writes it.
createProgress.next.describe.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel. A coding agent is the AI that writes the code.

createProgress.next.collaboratorsVote.text: Collaborators vote it in, and it goes live.
createProgress.next.collaboratorsVote.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel, when it is not known who the app is for. "it" is the change the coding agent wrote.

createProgress.next.membersVote.text: Members vote it in, and it goes live.
createProgress.next.membersVote.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel, for an app that belongs to a community. "it" is the change the coding agent wrote.

createProgress.next.soloApprove.text: You approve it, and it goes live.
createProgress.next.soloApprove.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel, for an app only this person uses. "it" is the change the coding agent wrote.

createProgress.next.botBuilds.text: Homeroom bot builds the first version from your description.
createProgress.next.botBuilds.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel, when the assistant writes the first version. "Homeroom bot" is the assistant's name and stays as it is.

createProgress.next.botMessages.text: It messages you in your chat when it’s ready, and asks there if anything is unclear.
createProgress.next.botMessages.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel, after "Homeroom bot builds the first version from your description." "It" is the bot.

createProgress.next.firstRequest.text: Your description is the project’s first request.
createProgress.next.firstRequest.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel, when the person's description was filed as a request (an item asking for a change).

createProgress.next.startChange.text: Start a change from it, and a coding agent writes it.
createProgress.next.startChange.description: One of three numbered lines under "What happens next" in the app-creation progress panel, after "Your description is the project’s first request." The first "it" is that request; the second is the change.

createProgress.openApp.description: Button in the app-creation progress panel once the app is running: opens the new app. "Open" is a verb.

createProgress.viewApp.description: Second, quieter button in the app-creation progress panel, shown while the assistant is still building the first version and the main button leads to its chat: opens the new app as it is now. "Open" is a verb.

createProgress.setSecrets.description: Button in the app-creation progress panel when the app needs secrets before it can start: opens the dialog where they are entered.

createApp.error.network.description: Error on a create-project form when the request could not reach the server.

createApp.error.status.text: Homeroom couldn’t create the project ({{status}}). Try again in a moment.
createApp.error.status.description: Error on a create-project form when the server refused and gave no reason. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code. Homeroom is the product's name.

fork.title.named.description: Heading of the dialog for making one's own copy of an app. "Remix" is a verb. {{app}} is the name of the app being copied; keep the numbered tag around it.

fork.title.unnamed.description: Heading of the remix dialog when the name of the app being copied is not known. "Remix" is a verb. Keep the numbered tag around "this app".

fork.intro.text: Make your own copy. You get the code and the look, and it starts as Just you.
fork.intro.description: Line under the heading of the remix dialog. "Just you" is the name of the audience setting for an app only its maker can use; keep it as a name.

fork.nameLabel.description: Label of the text field in the remix dialog where the copy's name is typed.

fork.namePlaceholder.description: Greyed example text inside the empty name field of the remix dialog.

fork.defaultName.named.description: Name the remix dialog suggests for the copy, filled into the name field. {{app}} is the name of the app being copied.

fork.defaultName.unnamed.description: Name the remix dialog suggests for the copy when the name of the app being copied is not known.

fork.info.copied.text: <0>Copied:</0> the code, the look and the icon.
fork.info.copied.description: First line of the box in the remix dialog that says what a copy holds. The numbered tag makes the lead-in bold.

fork.info.fresh.text: <0>Starts fresh:</0> it’s Just you, with an empty database. Invite people or open it up later.
fork.info.fresh.description: Second line of the box in the remix dialog. "Just you" is the name of the audience setting for an app only its maker can use. The numbered tag makes the lead-in bold.

fork.info.notCopied.text: <0>Not copied:</0> anyone’s data, keys, chat or members. If the app needs a key, you’ll add your own before it goes live.
fork.info.notCopied.description: Third line of the box in the remix dialog. A key is a secret such as an API key. The numbered tag makes the lead-in bold.

fork.info.public.text: Its code is public on GitHub.
fork.info.public.description: Last line of the box in the remix dialog: the copy's source code can be read by anyone on GitHub.

fork.submit.description: Button in the remix dialog: makes the copy. A verb.

fork.submitting.description: Text of the remix dialog's button while the copy is being requested.

fork.error.nameShort.text: Name must be at least 3 characters.
fork.error.nameShort.description: Error in the remix dialog when the copy's name is shorter than 3 characters.

fork.error.failed.description: Error in the remix dialog when the server refused to make the copy and gave no reason.

fork.error.network.description: Error in the remix dialog when the request could not reach the server.

fork.beingMade.text: Your copy is being made. It will appear in your apps when it is ready.
fork.beingMade.description: Brief message at the bottom of the screen after a remix was accepted but its progress cannot be shown; the dialog closes and Home opens.

fork.retry.http.description: Shown under "Details" in the progress panel when asking the server to retry a failed remix was refused without a reason. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code.

fork.retry.unreachable.text: Could not reach the server to retry. Try again from the app tile.
fork.retry.unreachable.description: Shown under "Details" in the progress panel when the retry of a failed remix could not be sent. The app tile is the app's icon on Home.

importPr.title.description: Heading of the dialog that brings an existing GitHub pull request into the app's board.

importPr.intro.text: Pick an open pull request to add to In progress. It stays there until you ask for approval.
importPr.intro.description: Line under the heading of the import dialog. "In progress" is the name of a column of the app's board; keep it as a name.

importPr.previewNote.text: A staging preview is built from the pull request's head commit, so it takes a few minutes to appear, and automated checks stay pending until it does. Rows marked <0>from a fork</0> are branches in someone else's repository: review the changes on GitHub before importing.
importPr.previewNote.description: Second paragraph of the import dialog. The numbered tag colours "from a fork" like the mark on those rows; translate it the same way as that mark.

importPr.list.loading.description: Shown in the list of the import dialog while the app's open pull requests are being fetched.

importPr.list.loadFailed.text: Couldn’t load pull requests. Please try again.
importPr.list.loadFailed.description: Error in place of the list in the import dialog when the request for the pull requests could not be sent.

importPr.list.notConfigured.text: GitHub isn’t configured for this app, so there’s nothing to import.
importPr.list.notConfigured.description: Note in place of the list in the import dialog when the app has no usable GitHub repository.

importPr.list.empty.text: No open pull requests are available to import right now.
importPr.list.empty.description: Note in place of the list in the import dialog when the repository has no pull request that could be imported.

importPr.row.unknownAuthor.description: Stands in for the author's GitHub username on a row of the import dialog when the pull request has none recorded. Lower case, like a username.

importPr.row.fromFork.description: Amber mark on a row of the import dialog whose branch lives in another repository. {{repository}} is that repository's name, such as someone/app; keep the numbered tag around it.

importPr.row.fromUnknownFork.description: Amber mark on a row of the import dialog whose branch lives in another repository whose name is not known. Keep the numbered tag around "unknown fork".

importPr.row.forkTooltip.text: This branch lives in a fork, not in this app's own repository. The preview is built from the pull request's head commit. Review the changes on GitHub before importing.
importPr.row.forkTooltip.description: Tooltip of the "from a fork" mark on a row of the import dialog.

importPr.row.viewOnGitHub.description: Link on a row of the import dialog: opens that pull request on GitHub in a new tab. Keep the arrow at the end.

importPr.progress.text: Importing PR #{{number}}: checking it on GitHub and adding it to In progress…
importPr.progress.description: Shown beside a spinner in the import dialog while the chosen pull request (PR) is imported. {{number}} is its number; keep the # before it. "In progress" is the name of a board column.

importPr.slow.text: Still working. GitHub is being slow, so don’t close this window.
importPr.slow.description: Shown under the progress line of the import dialog when the import has taken more than a few seconds.

importPr.submit.description: Button in the import dialog: imports the selected pull request. A verb.

importPr.submitting.description: Text of the import dialog's button while the pull request is being imported.

importPr.imported.text: PR #{{number}} was imported. Its preview is being built now. Find it in Dev under In progress.
importPr.imported.description: Brief message at the bottom of the screen after an import succeeded but its page could not be opened. {{number}} is the pull request's number; keep the # before it. "Dev" is the name of a tab and "In progress" of a board column.

importPr.error.pick.text: Pick a pull request to import.
importPr.error.pick.description: Error in the import dialog when Import was pressed with no pull request selected.

importPr.error.network.description: Error in the import dialog when the import request could not reach the server.

importPr.error.notFound.text: PR #{{number}} wasn’t found on GitHub. It may have been deleted.
importPr.error.notFound.description: Error in the import dialog when GitHub no longer has the chosen pull request (PR). {{number}} is its number; keep the # before it.

importPr.error.conflict.text: PR #{{number}} can’t be imported right now.
importPr.error.conflict.description: Error in the import dialog when the chosen pull request (PR) cannot be imported in its present state. {{number}} is its number; keep the # before it.

importPr.error.restarting.text: The platform is restarting. Try the import again in a few seconds.
importPr.error.restarting.description: Error in the import dialog when the server is briefly unavailable. "The platform" is Homeroom.

importPr.error.generic.text: Something went wrong importing this PR. Please try again.
importPr.error.generic.description: Error in the import dialog when the import failed and the server gave no reason. PR is a pull request.

walletRecovery.title.description: Heading of a dialog in the mobile app, shown when no new wallet can be made for the person: they can attach the wallet of an account they made earlier with an email address.

walletRecovery.intro.text: No new mobile wallet is available. If you previously joined with email, prove that address to connect its current-season wallet.
walletRecovery.intro.description: Line under the heading of the wallet recovery dialog. A season is a period of the programme; each account has one wallet per season.

walletRecovery.emailLabel.description: Label of the email field in the wallet recovery dialog: the address of the account the person made earlier.

walletRecovery.emailPlaceholder.description: Greyed example inside the empty email field of the wallet recovery dialog. Keep it a made-up address at example.com.

walletRecovery.sendCode.description: Button beside the email field in the wallet recovery dialog: emails a six-digit code to that address.

walletRecovery.sending.description: Text of the "Send code" button in the wallet recovery dialog while the code is being sent.

walletRecovery.codeLabel.description: Label of the field in the wallet recovery dialog where the six-digit code from the email is typed.

walletRecovery.connect.description: Main button of the wallet recovery dialog: checks the code and attaches the earlier account's wallet.

walletRecovery.connecting.description: Text of the main button of the wallet recovery dialog while the wallet is being attached or sign-in is finishing.

walletRecovery.retrySignIn.description: Text of the main button of the wallet recovery dialog after the wallet was attached but signing in to the app did not finish: retries the sign-in.

walletRecovery.status.checkEmail.text: Check that email for a six-digit code.
walletRecovery.status.checkEmail.description: Status in the wallet recovery dialog after the code was sent. "That email" is the address the person typed.

walletRecovery.status.connected.description: Status in the wallet recovery dialog after the wallet was attached, while the mobile app signs in.

walletRecovery.error.email.text: Enter the email address used by your previous account.
walletRecovery.error.email.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the email field is empty or is not an address.

walletRecovery.error.code.text: Enter the six-digit code from the email.
walletRecovery.error.code.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the code field does not hold six digits.

walletRecovery.error.send.text: Could not send a code. Please try again.
walletRecovery.error.send.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the code could not be emailed and the server gave no reason.

walletRecovery.error.rotation.text: That wallet was already installed elsewhere. Moving it safely requires key rotation, which is not available yet.
walletRecovery.error.rotation.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the wallet is in use on another device. Key rotation is replacing the wallet's cryptographic key.

walletRecovery.error.claim.text: Could not connect that wallet. Check the email and code, then try again.
walletRecovery.error.claim.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the server refused to attach the wallet and gave no reason.

walletRecovery.error.connect.text: Could not connect that wallet. Please try again.
walletRecovery.error.connect.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the request to attach the wallet could not reach the server.

walletRecovery.error.update.text: Update the Homeroom app to finish connecting this wallet.
walletRecovery.error.update.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the installed mobile app is too old to finish. Homeroom is the product's name.

walletRecovery.error.signIn.text: The wallet is connected, but app sign-in did not finish. Try again.
walletRecovery.error.signIn.description: Error in the wallet recovery dialog when the wallet was attached but the mobile app could not sign in.

feedback.heading.description: Heading of the dialog where a person writes a request for a change to an app or to Homeroom.

feedback.intro.text: Members can see it, vote on it and pick it up.
feedback.intro.description: Line under the heading of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. "it" is the request being written; to pick it up is to start working on it.

feedback.dropLabel.text: Drop images or a clip to attach
feedback.dropLabel.description: Shown over the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while files are dragged over it. A clip is a short video.

feedback.target.label.description: Question above the two choices in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog: whether the request is about the app that is open or about Homeroom itself.

feedback.target.thisApp.description: First line of the app choice in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the open app has no name to show.

feedback.target.noApp.description: First line of the app choice in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when no app is open, so the choice is greyed out.

feedback.target.appSub.description: Second, smaller line of the app choice in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog, under the app's name: says the name above is the app that is open.

feedback.target.platformSub.description: Second, smaller line of the Homeroom choice in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog, under the name Homeroom: the request is about Homeroom, not about one app.

feedback.target.choose.description: Red line under the two choices in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when "Post request" was pressed before either was picked.

feedback.title.label.description: Label of the title field in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. The numbered tag sets "optional" in grey; keep the space at the start of it.

feedback.title.placeholder.description: Greyed text inside the empty title field of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog: a title is proposed automatically while the description is typed.

feedback.title.generating.description: Greyed text inside the empty title field of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while a title is being worked out from the description.

feedback.description.label.description: Label of the large text box in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog, where the request is described.

feedback.description.placeholder.text: Describe the change, or the problem you hit
feedback.description.placeholder.description: Greyed text inside the empty description box of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog.

feedback.description.required.description: Red line under the description box of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when "Post request" was pressed with nothing written.

feedback.screenshot.attach.description: Button in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog on a computer: lets the person mark an area of the page to attach as a picture.

feedback.screenshot.attachAnother.description: The same button in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog once at least one picture is attached: attaches another screenshot.

feedback.screenshot.take.description: Button in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog in the mobile app: captures the screen behind the dialog and attaches it.

feedback.screenshot.takeAnother.description: The same button in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog in the mobile app once at least one picture is attached: takes another screenshot.

feedback.screenshot.limit_one.text: You can attach up to {{count}} images.
feedback.screenshot.limit_one.description: Small line under the attach buttons of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while nothing is attached. {{count}} is the most images one request may carry.

feedback.screenshot.limit_other.text: You can attach up to {{count}} images.
feedback.screenshot.limit_other.description: Small line under the attach buttons of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while nothing is attached. {{count}} is the most images one request may carry.

feedback.screenshot.attached_one.description: Small line under the attach buttons of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{attached}} is how many images are attached and {{count}} the most a request may carry.

feedback.screenshot.attached_other.description: Small line under the attach buttons of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{attached}} is how many images are attached and {{count}} the most a request may carry.

feedback.screenshot.attachedFull_one.text: {{attached}} of {{count}} images attached. Remove one to add another.
feedback.screenshot.attachedFull_one.description: Small line under the attach buttons of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when no more images fit. {{attached}} is how many are attached and {{count}} the most a request may carry.

feedback.screenshot.attachedFull_other.text: {{attached}} of {{count}} images attached. Remove one to add another.
feedback.screenshot.attachedFull_other.description: Small line under the attach buttons of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when no more images fit. {{attached}} is how many are attached and {{count}} the most a request may carry.

feedback.screenshot.previewAlt.description: Text alternative of an attached image's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{number}} is its position among the attached images, starting at 1.

feedback.screenshot.remove.description: Accessible name of the X button on an attached image's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{number}} is its position among the attached images, starting at 1.

feedback.screenshot.uploading.description: Shown on an attached image's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while the image is being uploaded.

feedback.screenshot.savedOffline.text: Saved with your feedback. It'll upload when you're back online
feedback.screenshot.savedOffline.description: Shown on an attached image's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when it could not be uploaded because there is no connection.

feedback.screenshot.uploadFailed.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the server refused an attached image and gave no reason.

feedback.screenshot.uploadLater.text: Couldn't upload the screenshot yet. It'll be sent along with your feedback.
feedback.screenshot.uploadLater.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when an attached image could not be uploaded because there is no connection.

feedback.screenshot.stillUploading.text: Screenshot is still uploading, one moment…
feedback.screenshot.stillUploading.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when "Post request" was pressed while an attached image is still uploading.

feedback.screenshot.lost.text: The screenshot didn't make it, but your feedback is safe. Here it is again.
feedback.screenshot.lost.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the dialog reopens after a screen capture that was interrupted: the typed text was kept and is shown again.

feedback.capture.waiting.text: Still waiting for your browser to share the screen. If you already chose what to share and nothing happened, restart the browser, or choose an image instead. Your feedback is safe.
feedback.capture.waiting.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the browser's screen-sharing prompt has not answered for a while. "Your feedback is safe" reassures the person that what they typed is not lost.

feedback.capture.declined.text: Screen capture was declined. Nothing was attached, and your feedback is safe.
feedback.capture.declined.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the person refused the browser's screen-sharing prompt. "Your feedback is safe" reassures the person that what they typed is not lost.

feedback.capture.blank.text: The shared window came through blank. On a Mac, allow your browser under System Settings, Privacy & Security, Screen & System Audio Recording, then try again. Your feedback is safe.
feedback.capture.blank.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the captured picture is empty. The three names after "under" are the path to a macOS setting; use the names macOS shows in the translator's language. "Your feedback is safe" reassures the person that what they typed is not lost.

feedback.capture.smallWindow.text: That was a small window, not this page. Try again and share the window showing this page, or your whole screen. Your feedback is safe.
feedback.capture.smallWindow.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the person shared the wrong window with the browser's screen-sharing prompt. "Your feedback is safe" reassures the person that what they typed is not lost.

feedback.capture.notFound.text: Couldn't locate this page in the shared window. Keep it fully visible and try again. Your feedback is safe.
feedback.capture.notFound.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the page could not be found in what the person shared. "it" is this page. "Your feedback is safe" reassures the person that what they typed is not lost.

feedback.capture.tooLarge.text: That screenshot is larger than 4 MB. Your feedback is safe, attach a smaller one.
feedback.capture.tooLarge.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a captured picture is too big to attach. "Your feedback is safe" reassures the person that what they typed is not lost.

feedback.capture.failedPickPhoto.text: Couldn't take a screenshot, but your feedback is safe. Choose one from Photos, or just send it as it is.
feedback.capture.failedPickPhoto.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog in the mobile app when capturing the screen failed. Photos is the phone's picture library. "it" in the last part is the request.

feedback.capture.failed.text: Screenshot capture failed, but your feedback is safe. Try again, or send it without one.
feedback.capture.failed.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when capturing the screen failed for an unknown reason. "it" is the request.

feedback.image.wrongType.text: Choose a PNG or JPEG image.
feedback.image.wrongType.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a file picked or dropped as an image is in a format that cannot be attached.

feedback.image.tooLarge.text: That image is larger than 4 MB.
feedback.image.tooLarge.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a picked or dropped image is too big to attach.

feedback.image.failed.text: Couldn't attach that image. Please try another.
feedback.image.failed.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a picked or dropped image could not be read.

feedback.image.onlyFirst_one.text: You can attach up to {{max}} images, so only the first one was added.
feedback.image.onlyFirst_one.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when more images were picked than still fit. {{max}} is the most a request may carry; {{count}} is how many were added.

feedback.image.onlyFirst_other.text: You can attach up to {{max}} images, so only the first {{count}} were added.
feedback.image.onlyFirst_other.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when more images were picked than still fit. {{max}} is the most a request may carry; {{count}} is how many were added.

feedback.image.dropLimit_one.text: You can attach up to {{count}} images.
feedback.image.dropLimit_one.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog, in red, when an image was dropped on the dialog although no more fit. {{count}} is the most images one request may carry.

feedback.image.dropLimit_other.text: You can attach up to {{count}} images.
feedback.image.dropLimit_other.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog, in red, when an image was dropped on the dialog although no more fit. {{count}} is the most images one request may carry.

feedback.drop.wrongType.text: Drop an image or a video clip.
feedback.drop.wrongType.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when files dropped on the dialog are neither images nor video.

feedback.attach.button.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the paperclip button in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog: opens a small menu with Photo and Video.

feedback.attach.menu.description: Accessible name of the small menu the paperclip button of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog opens. A verb.

feedback.attach.photo.description: Row of the paperclip menu in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog: picks one or more pictures from the device to attach.

feedback.video.add.description: Row of the paperclip menu in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog: picks a video clip from the device to attach.

feedback.video.replace.description: The Video row of the paperclip menu in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog once a clip is attached: picks a different clip in its place.

feedback.video.remove.description: Accessible name of the X button on the attached video's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog.

feedback.video.checking.description: Shown on the attached video's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while its length and format are being read.

feedback.video.uploading.description: Shown on the attached video's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while the clip is being uploaded.

feedback.video.savedOffline.text: Saved with your feedback. It'll upload when you're back online
feedback.video.savedOffline.description: Shown on the attached video's thumbnail in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when it could not be uploaded because there is no connection.

feedback.video.tooLarge.text: Clips can be up to 50 MB.
feedback.video.tooLarge.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a chosen video file is too big. A clip is a short video.

feedback.video.unreadable.text: Couldn't read that clip. Try an MP4, WebM or MOV recording.
feedback.video.unreadable.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a chosen video cannot be played by the browser. MP4, WebM and MOV are file formats.

feedback.video.tooLong.text: Clips can be up to 60 seconds long. Trim it and try again.
feedback.video.tooLong.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a chosen video is longer than a minute.

feedback.video.uploadFailed.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the server refused the attached video and gave no reason.

feedback.video.uploadLater.text: Couldn't upload the video yet. It'll be sent along with your feedback.
feedback.video.uploadLater.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the attached video could not be uploaded because there is no connection.

feedback.video.failed.text: Couldn't attach that clip. Please try another.
feedback.video.failed.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a chosen video could not be attached for an unknown reason.

feedback.video.stillUploading.text: Video is still uploading, one moment…
feedback.video.stillUploading.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when "Post request" was pressed while the attached video is still uploading.

feedback.state.label.text: <0>Include app state:</0>this app can attach a snapshot of its current state to help debugging
feedback.state.label.description: Label of a checkbox in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog, shown when the open app offers to describe what it is showing. The numbered tag makes the lead-in darker.

feedback.state.filingWithout.text: Couldn't collect app state, filing without it…
feedback.state.filingWithout.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while the request is being posted, when the app did not hand over its state snapshot.

feedback.state.filedWithout.text: Couldn't collect app state, so it was filed without it.
feedback.state.filedWithout.description: Sentence added to the confirmation after a request was posted, when the app did not hand over its state snapshot. The first "it" is the request.

feedback.bounty.label.text: <0>Put a kudos on this</0> to thank whoever solves it
feedback.bounty.label.description: Label of a checkbox in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog: attaches one kudos (a token of thanks, of which a person has a weekly allowance) to the request as a reward. Keep "kudos" as the product uses it. The numbered tag makes the first part darker.

feedback.bounty.cost.description: Note under the kudos checkbox in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the person's remaining weekly allowance is not known.

feedback.bounty.costRemaining_one.text: Costs 1 kudos. {{count}} of {{limit}} left this week
feedback.bounty.costRemaining_one.description: Note under the kudos checkbox in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{count}} is how many kudos the person can still give this week and {{limit}} their weekly allowance.

feedback.bounty.costRemaining_other.text: Costs 1 kudos. {{count}} of {{limit}} left this week
feedback.bounty.costRemaining_other.description: Note under the kudos checkbox in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{count}} is how many kudos the person can still give this week and {{limit}} their weekly allowance.

feedback.bounty.usedAll_one.text: You've used all {{count}} kudos this week. Resets {{when}}.
feedback.bounty.usedAll_one.description: Note under the disabled kudos checkbox in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{count}} is the weekly allowance. {{when}} says when it is renewed, already worded for the sentence, for example "Monday at 2:00 AM".

feedback.bounty.usedAll_other.text: You've used all {{count}} kudos this week. Resets {{when}}.
feedback.bounty.usedAll_other.description: Note under the disabled kudos checkbox in the "Suggest an improvement" dialog. {{count}} is the weekly allowance. {{when}} says when it is renewed, already worded for the sentence, for example "Monday at 2:00 AM".

feedback.bounty.usedAllUtc_one.text: You've used all {{count}} kudos this week. Resets Monday 00:00 UTC.
feedback.bounty.usedAllUtc_one.description: The same note when the renewal time cannot be shown in the person's own time zone. {{count}} is the weekly allowance. UTC is the time standard and stays as it is.

feedback.bounty.usedAllUtc_other.text: You've used all {{count}} kudos this week. Resets Monday 00:00 UTC.
feedback.bounty.usedAllUtc_other.description: The same note when the renewal time cannot be shown in the person's own time zone. {{count}} is the weekly allowance. UTC is the time standard and stays as it is.

feedback.bounty.pledged_one.text: Pledged 1 kudos as a bounty. {{count}} left this week.
feedback.bounty.pledged_one.description: Sentence added to the confirmation after a request was posted with the kudos checkbox ticked. {{count}} is how many kudos the person can still give this week. A bounty is a reward for whoever solves the request.

feedback.bounty.pledged_other.text: Pledged 1 kudos as a bounty. {{count}} left this week.
feedback.bounty.pledged_other.description: Sentence added to the confirmation after a request was posted with the kudos checkbox ticked. {{count}} is how many kudos the person can still give this week. A bounty is a reward for whoever solves the request.

feedback.bounty.failedReason.description: Sentence added to the confirmation after a request was posted but its kudos reward was refused. {{reason}} is the server's own explanation, a clause without a final full stop.

feedback.bounty.failed.text: Couldn't add the bounty: the bounty could not be placed.
feedback.bounty.failed.description: Sentence added to the confirmation after a request was posted but its kudos reward was refused without an explanation.

feedback.queue.retry.description: Button under the status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while a message saved on this device has not been sent: tries to send it now.

feedback.queue.retrying.description: Text of that "Try again" button while the saved messages are being sent.

feedback.queue.offline.text: You're offline. Your message will be saved on this device and sent automatically when you're back online.
feedback.queue.offline.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while there is no connection and nothing is waiting to be sent.

feedback.queue.offlineWaiting_one.text: You're offline. {{count}} message saved on this device is waiting to send. This one will be saved too.
feedback.queue.offlineWaiting_one.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while there is no connection. {{count}} is how many earlier messages are saved and unsent. "This one" is the message being written.

feedback.queue.offlineWaiting_other.text: You're offline. {{count}} messages saved on this device are waiting to send. This one will be saved too.
feedback.queue.offlineWaiting_other.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while there is no connection. {{count}} is how many earlier messages are saved and unsent. "This one" is the message being written.

feedback.queue.waiting_one.text: {{count}} message saved on this device hasn't been sent yet.
feedback.queue.waiting_one.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while connected. {{count}} is how many messages saved earlier are still unsent.

feedback.queue.waiting_other.text: {{count}} messages saved on this device haven't been sent yet.
feedback.queue.waiting_other.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog while connected. {{count}} is how many messages saved earlier are still unsent.

feedback.queue.saved.text: Saved on this device. We'll send it as soon as you're back online.
feedback.queue.saved.description: Green status line of the "suggest an improvement" dialog after a message was saved because there is no connection.

feedback.queue.savedWithoutVideo.text: Saved on this device without the video, which needs a connection to upload. We'll send the rest as soon as you're back online.
feedback.queue.savedWithoutVideo.description: Green status line of the "suggest an improvement" dialog after a message was saved because there is no connection and its video had to be left out.

feedback.queue.refused.duplicate.text: You've already saved this message. It'll send once you're back online.
feedback.queue.refused.duplicate.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the same message is already saved on this device and waiting to be sent.

feedback.queue.refused.full_one.text: Only {{count}} messages can wait offline at once. The earlier ones send first.
feedback.queue.refused.full_one.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when no more messages can be saved on this device. {{count}} is the most that can wait.

feedback.queue.refused.full_other.text: Only {{count}} messages can wait offline at once. The earlier ones send first.
feedback.queue.refused.full_other.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when no more messages can be saved on this device. {{count}} is the most that can wait.

feedback.queue.refused.tooLarge.text: There isn't room to keep another screenshot offline. Remove it and save the text.
feedback.queue.refused.tooLarge.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when the device has no room to keep the attached image until there is a connection. "it" is the screenshot.

feedback.queue.refused.failed.text: Couldn't save this message on this device.
feedback.queue.refused.failed.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a message could not be saved for sending later.

feedback.queue.rejectedReason.text: This message couldn't be sent: {{reason}}. Your text is back, so edit it and try again.
feedback.queue.rejectedReason.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a saved message was refused by the server and its text was put back in the form. {{reason}} is the server's own explanation, a clause without a final full stop.

feedback.queue.rejected.text: This message couldn't be sent: the server rejected it. Your text is back, so edit it and try again.
feedback.queue.rejected.description: Status line of the "Suggest an improvement" dialog when a saved message was refused by the server without an explanation and its text was put back in the form.

feedback.queue.stillWaiting_one.text: Still couldn't send it. It's kept on this device and will try again by itself.
